title: Daily Donchian trend-following on BTC/ETH/SOL perps, leverage <= 3x
honesty_note: Not a clean out-of-sample test: the author has seen the 2025-26 regime and read August 2026 candles while writing the dossier. Parameters are textbook defaults (Turtle System 1) with no search. The only clean out-of-sample data will be the Stage B forward run.

instruments.proxy_limits: USDT-margined global swaps stand in for USD-margined dated X-Perps (listed only since April 2026). Basis, funding and liquidity can differ; X-Perp books are thinner; EEA retail leverage cap is unverified (OKX markets 'up to 10x').

data.candles: https://www.okx.com/api/v5/market/history-candles, bar 1Dutc (primary) and 4H (secondary), paginated with 'after', ascending after fetch
data.funding: OKX /api/v5/public/funding-rate-history for the instrument where it covers the timestamp (only ~1 month back); otherwise Binance https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/fundingRate for BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT / SOLUSDT. Source is logged per funding event.
data.cash_benchmark: FRED DTB3 (3-month T-bill, discount basis, percent), https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DTB3

sample.note: Bars before 2021-03-01 are warm-up only; no position may be opened before the start date. Open positions at the end are closed at the last close of 2026-10-31 with the normal exit costs.

rule.name: Donchian breakout, Turtle System 1 defaults, no pyramiding
rule.secondary_note: Same rule and lookbacks counted in bars. Reported only; it cannot rescue a failed primary.
rule.atr_method: Turtle N: seed = simple mean of the first 20 true ranges, then N_t = (19 * N_{t-1} + TR_t) / 20
rule.long_entry: close_t > max(high over the 20 bars before t)
rule.short_entry: close_t < min(low over the 20 bars before t)
rule.long_exit: close_t < min(low over the 10 bars before t), or the stop
rule.short_exit: close_t > max(high over the 10 bars before t), or the stop
rule.stop: long: entry fill - 2 * N at the signal bar; short: entry fill + 2 * N. Checked on every later bar's low/high. If the bar opens beyond the stop, fill at the open; otherwise at the stop price. Slippage and fee apply.
rule.execution: Signals use the closed bar; entries and channel exits fill at the next bar's open. A same-bar exit signal plus opposite entry signal closes and reverses at the next open.
rule.positions: At most one position per instrument.

sizing.sleeves: Equal thirds per instrument, no rebalancing between sleeves.
sizing.notional: leverage x sleeve equity at entry (sleeve equity = sleeve cash, positions are flat at entry)
sizing.margin_mode: isolated; margin = notional / leverage = the whole sleeve equity
sizing.counterfactual_note: 40x is above what OKX Europe offers (up to 10x). Reported only to show what the top-1's leverage would have done to this rule.

costs.taker_fee_source: https://www.okx.com/en-eu/x-perps FAQ, read 2026-11-07: '2 bps maker and 5 bps taker for standard accounts'
costs.slippage_direction: Buys fill higher, sells fill lower, entries and exits alike.
costs.funding: Every funding timestamp strictly after the entry fill time and at or before the exit fill time: payment = rate * qty * entry fill price. Longs pay a positive rate, shorts receive it; negative rates reverse.

liquidation.check: Every bar after entry: long if low <= liq, short if high >= liq. If the stop and the liquidation are both reachable in the same bar, book whichever result is worse for us.
liquidation.loss: A liquidated position loses its whole margin (the sleeve goes to zero at these settings) plus the entry fee already paid. A sleeve at zero stops trading.

metrics.equity_curve: Portfolio equity = sum of sleeves, marked at every bar close (cash + unrealized PnL - accrued funding).
metrics.trade_return: net PnL of the trade (after fees, slippage, funding) / sleeve equity at entry
metrics.max_drawdown: largest peak-to-trough decline of the portfolio equity curve

kill_criteria.K-A1: Primary 1D, 1x: portfolio growth over the sample <= T-bill growth over the same dates (DTB3 compounded daily, actual/360, last available rate carried over non-trading days). KILL.
kill_criteria.K-A2: Primary 1D, 1x: product of (1 + trade_return) over all trades except the 5 largest trade_returns, minus 1, <= 0. KILL.
kill_criteria.K-A3: Primary 1D, 3x: max drawdown > 30 %. KILL (the leverage claim; owner may still see the 1x result).
kill_criteria.K-A4: Primary 1D, 1x: fewer than 60 closed trades pooled across the three instruments. KILL (no power).
kill_criteria.K-A5: Primary 1D, 1x: portfolio growth <= 0 in either half. KILL (regime dependence).
report_only: BTC buy-and-hold 1x over the sample (first open to last close)
Per instrument: trades, win rate, net return, fees, funding
Liquidations per leverage run, including the 40x counterfactual
Secondary 4H results for the same criteria
kill_criteria.verdict: PASS only if K-A1..K-A5 all pass on the primary 1D rule. Any failure = KILL; nothing is tuned and re-run.
